name: Zaham
title: Son of King Rehoboam
summary: Zaham was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Mahalath. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Rehoboam's descendants in 2 Chronicles. Zaham played no prominent role in the biblical narrative but is noted as part of the royal house of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Rehoboam's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Zaham is mentioned as one of the sons of King Rehoboam and his wife Mahalath, daughter of Jerimoth, son of David.

keyEvents.title: Rehoboam's marriage to Mahalath
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam took Mahalath, daughter of Jerimoth, son of David, and Abihail, daughter of Eliab, son of Jesse, as his wife. She bore him sons, including Zaham.

keyEvents.title: Rehoboam's royal family
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam had many wives and concubines, and his sons were scattered throughout the cities of Judah and Benjamin as leaders. Zoham was among these royal sons.

keyEvents.title: Abijah Chosen as Successor
keyEvents.description: Despite Rehoboam having many sons, including Zoham, he appointed Abijah, the son of Maacah, as chief among his brothers to make him king.
